agentTool.name: acn_identity_security_hub
agentTool.description: Calls M5 in-process for identification and authentication. Returns auth_level, customer_id, auth_mode, auth_error. Never transfers — caller retains full conversation control. Speak a brief pacing phrase BEFORE calling — match the phrase to what is actually happening: identification → 'One moment while I pull up your account.'; OTP issuance → 'I'll send a code to your mobile now.'; OTP verification → 'Verifying your code now.'; step-up → 'One more security step — just a moment.'. Never say 'verify your identity' if the customer is already identified.
